Ontology_ProcessingAndDifferential_promp.notes: The study describes a method called Ub-POD which uses proximity-based biotinylation of an Avi-tag on Ubiquitin to identify E3 ligase substrates. While the biological focus is on ubiquitination, the MS analysis identifies the proteins themselves (protein-level quantification) rather than the specific diGly sites, as the biotin is on the N-terminal tag of Ub, not the lysine remnant.
